title: Lay Egg Behavior
description: Allows the mob to lay an egg block on certain types of blocks if the mob is pregnant.

allow_laying_from_below.title: Allow Laying From Below
allow_laying_from_below.description:
Allows the mob to lay its eggs from below the target if it can't get there. This is useful if the target block is water with air above, since mobs may not be able to get to the air block above water.

Sample values:
• frog: true

egg_type.title: Egg Type
egg_type.description:
Block type for the egg to lay. If this is a turtle egg, the number of eggs in the block is randomly set.

Sample values:
• frog: minecraft:frog_spawn

goal_radius.title: Goal Radius
goal_radius.description:
Distance in blocks within the mob considers it has reached the goal. This is the "wiggle room" to stop the AI from bouncing back and forth trying to reach a specific spot

Sample values:
• frog: 1.7

lay_egg_sound.title: Lay Egg Sound
lay_egg_sound.description:
Name of the sound event played when laying the egg. Defaults to lay_egg, which is used for Turtles.

Sample values:
• frog: lay_spawn

lay_seconds.title: Lay Seconds
lay_seconds.description:
Duration of the laying egg process in seconds.

Sample values:
• frog: 2

on_lay.title: Lay

search_height.title: Search Height
search_height.description:
Height in blocks the mob will look for a target block to move towards

Sample values:
• frog: 3

search_range.title: Search Range
search_range.description:
The distance in blocks it will look for a target block to move towards

Sample values:
• frog: 10

speed_multiplier.title: Speed Multiplier
speed_multiplier.description:
Movement speed multiplier of the mob when using this AI Goal

Sample values:
• frog: 1

target_blocks.title: Target Blocks
target_blocks.description:
Blocks that the mob can lay its eggs on top of.

Sample values:
• frog: ["minecraft:water"]

target_materials_above_block.title: Target Materials Above Block
target_materials_above_block.description:
Types of materials that can exist above the target block. Valid types are Air, Water, and Lava.

Sample values:
• frog: ["Air"]

use_default_animation.title: Use Default Animation
use_default_animation.description: Specifies if the default lay-egg animation should be played when the egg is placed or not.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: As priority approaches 0, the priority is increased. The higher the priority, the sooner this behavior will be executed as a goal.
